title: Tidal Takes a Stand: Millions of AI-Generated Songs to Be Deleted
subtitle: The music streaming service is removing content created entirely by artificial intelligence to protect human artists.

summary.en: Tidal has announced that it will remove all music tracks created entirely by artificial intelligence from its platform. This decision comes after a massive increase in AI-generated uploads over the past few months. The company believes these tracks harm human creators and take away royalty payments. Starting December 9, 27 million AI-only songs will be deleted from the service. Artists may still use AI tools, provided their work includes significant human elements.
summary.zh: Tidal 宣布將從其平台上移除所有完全由人工智慧創作的音樂曲目。這項決定是在過去幾個月人工智慧生成內容大量增加後所做出的。該公司認為這些曲目損害了人類創作者的權益並剝奪了版稅收入。自 12 月 9 日起，2700 萬首純人工智慧歌曲將從該服務中刪除。藝術家仍可使用人工智慧工具，前提是其作品必須包含顯著的人類元素。

paragraphs.en: In a major move for the music industry, the streaming platform Tidal has announced a strict new policy regarding artificial intelligence. Starting December 9, the company will delete all music tracks that were created entirely by AI. This decision marks a significant change from the company’s previous approach, which focused on labeling and limiting the profit potential of such content. According to Ars Technica, the platform is taking this hard stance because it believes that fully automated music causes real harm to human artists.
paragraphs.zh: 音樂產業出現重大變革，串流平台 Tidal 宣布針對人工智慧（AI）實施嚴格的新政策。自 12 月 9 日起，該公司將刪除所有完全由人工智慧創作的音樂曲目。這項決定標誌著該公司策略的重大轉變，過去其作法僅側重於標記此類內容並限制其獲利潛力。根據科技媒體 Ars Technica 報導，該平台採取如此強硬的立場，是因為認為全自動生成的音樂對人類藝術家造成了實質傷害。

paragraphs.en: This update follows a period of rapid growth in AI-generated content on the service. Earlier this year, in July 2026, Tidal introduced a policy to label songs made by AI and stop them from earning money. However, this measure was not enough to stop the flood of automated music. Ars Technica reports that in the last 90 days, 43 percent of all new uploads to the platform were created completely by AI. By November 6, that number had climbed to an impressive 60 percent. The company clearly felt that its earlier efforts were failing to address the problem effectively.
paragraphs.zh: 此次更新是在該服務平台上，人工智慧生成內容快速增長之後所做出的決定。今年 7 月，Tidal 曾推出一項政策，旨在標記人工智慧製作的歌曲並停止其獲利。然而，這些措施並不足以遏止自動化音樂的氾濫。Ars Technica 報導指出，在過去 90 天內，平台上所有新上傳的內容中，有 43% 完全由人工智慧創作。到了 11 月 6 日，這一數字更攀升至驚人的 60%。顯然，該公司認為先前的努力未能有效解決問題。

paragraphs.en: The scale of the upcoming cleanup is massive. Tidal currently hosts 27 million tracks that are labeled as AI-generated. These songs represent about 6.3 percent of the platform's total music catalog. While this sounds like a large number of songs to remove, the company believes the impact on listeners will be very small. According to data provided by Tidal, 96 percent of these AI-labeled tracks have not received a single play in the last three months. Because almost no one is listening to them, the company expects the deletion process to have no negative effect on the user experience.
paragraphs.zh: 即將進行的清理規模相當龐大。Tidal 目前託管了 2700 萬首被標記為人工智慧生成的曲目，這些歌曲約佔該平台音樂總庫的 6.3%。雖然聽起來要移除的歌曲數量龐大，但該公司認為對聽眾的影響將微乎其微。根據 Tidal 提供的數據，這些被標記為人工智慧的曲目中，有 96% 在過去三個月內未曾被播放過。由於幾乎沒有人收聽，該公司預計刪除過程不會對使用者體驗產生負面影響。

paragraphs.en: Why is Tidal doing this? The company explains that AI models can create sounds much faster than humans can write music. This speed allows AI users to fill the platform with content that lacks real value. Tidal is concerned that this trend misleads listeners and takes royalty payments—the money paid to artists when their songs are played—away from real human creators. Furthermore, the company has identified a growing problem with people using AI to impersonate famous artists. Ars Technica reports that Tidal has already removed approximately 66,000 tracks from its service for pretending to be real musicians, which was a violation of company rules even before this new update.
paragraphs.zh: Tidal 為何要這麼做？該公司解釋說，人工智慧模型創作聲音的速度遠快於人類創作音樂的速度。這種速度讓人工智慧使用者能以缺乏實質價值的內容充斥平台。Tidal 擔心這種趨勢會誤導聽眾，並剝奪真實人類創作者的版稅收入（即歌曲播放時支付給藝術家的費用）。此外，該公司發現越來越多人利用人工智慧冒充知名藝術家。Ars Technica 報導稱，Tidal 已經從服務中移除了約 66,000 首假冒真實音樂人的曲目，即便在新政策實施前，這類行為也已違反了公司規定。

paragraphs.en: It is important to note that this ban does not mean all AI technology is forbidden on the platform. Tidal has been careful to explain that it is only targeting music that is fully created by AI. Musicians are still allowed to use AI tools as part of their creative process, as long as the final product contains human elements. This distinction is meant to protect the creative work of human songwriters and performers while still allowing for the use of modern technology in the studio.
paragraphs.zh: 值得注意的是，這項禁令並不代表平台上禁止使用所有人工智慧技術。Tidal 特地說明，其目標僅針對完全由人工智慧創作的音樂。音樂人仍可將人工智慧工具作為創作過程的一部分，只要最終成品包含人類元素即可。這項區分旨在保護人類詞曲創作者與表演者的創意成果，同時仍允許在錄音室中使用現代科技。

paragraphs.en: This move by Tidal is part of a larger conversation happening across the music industry. While many other streaming services have chosen to simply label AI-generated content, Tidal is now leading the way with a much stricter approach. By removing these millions of tracks, the company hopes to ensure that its platform remains a place where human creativity is valued and rewarded. As the deadline of December 9 approaches, the industry will be watching closely to see if other streaming platforms follow Tidal’s lead in taking a harder stance against fully automated music. For now, the focus remains on clearing out the digital clutter to make space for genuine human artistry.
paragraphs.zh: Tidal 的這項舉措是音樂產業廣泛討論的一部分。儘管許多其他串流服務選擇僅標記人工智慧生成的內容，但 Tidal 現在正以更嚴格的作法引領潮流。透過移除這些數以百萬計的曲目，該公司希望確保其平台始終是一個重視並獎勵人類創意的地方。隨著 12 月 9 日期限臨近，業界將密切關注其他串流平台是否會跟進 Tidal，對全自動音樂採取更強硬的立場。目前，重點仍放在清除數位雜訊，為真實的人類藝術創作騰出空間。

keyTerms.definitionEn: A firm, uncompromising position or policy on a particular issue.
keyTerms.noteZh: 此處指對某事採取嚴格且不妥協的態度。文中：According to Ars Technica, the platform is taking this hard stance because it believes that fully automated music causes real harm to human artists.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A large, overwhelming amount of something arriving at once.
keyTerms.noteZh: 原意為洪水，此處比喻大量湧入的 AI 音樂。文中：However, this measure was not enough to stop the flood of automated music.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To increase in number, value, or amount.
keyTerms.noteZh: 原意為攀爬，此處用於描述數據增長。文中：By November 6, that number had climbed to an impressive 60 percent.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A collection of things lying about in an untidy mass; unwanted or useless items.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 雜亂的東西、無用的垃圾資訊。
keyTerms.noteZh: 指平台上無人聆聽且無價值的 AI 音樂。文中：For now, the focus remains on clearing out the digital clutter to make space for genuine human artistry.

previousArticles.title: Tidal to Delete Millions of AI-Generated Songs
previousArticles.summaryEn: Tidal has announced a major policy change to remove all music created entirely by artificial intelligence. Starting December 9, the platform will delete millions of tracks that were made without human input. This decision follows a rapid increase in AI-generated content appearing on the service. Tidal believes these tracks harm human creators by taking away royalty payments and confusing listeners. Other streaming companies are also trying to manage the rise of AI music through labels or filters.

quiz.question: What percentage of new uploads to Tidal were identified as fully AI-generated by November 6, 2026?
quiz.explanationZh: 根據文章第二段，文中明確指出在 7 月時 AI 歌曲佔比為 43%，到了 11 月 6 日，這個數字攀升至 60%。選項 A 是過去三個月的平均值；選項 C 是 AI 歌曲佔總目錄的比例；選項 D 則是這些歌曲中沒有被播放過的比例，因此 B 為正確答案。

quiz.question: Based on the article, why does Tidal believe the removal of 27 million tracks will not negatively affect the user experience?

options.A: Because those tracks will be replaced by human-made music immediately.
options.B: Because the platform's total catalog is too large for users to notice the difference.
options.C: Because the vast majority of these tracks have essentially no listeners.
options.D: Because the AI tracks were only meant to be used as background noise.

quiz.explanationZh: 文章第三段提到，雖然 2700 萬首歌曲聽起來很多，但數據顯示 96% 的 AI 標記歌曲在過去三個月內完全沒有被播放過。由此可推斷，既然幾乎沒人聽這些歌，移除它們對使用者體驗不會造成負面影響。其他選項皆未在文中提及或推論過度。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the phrase 'clearing out the digital clutter' refer to?

options.B: Organizing the platform's music library by genre.
options.C: Deleting files that contain technical errors.
options.D: Upgrading the platform's software for faster streaming.

quiz.explanationZh: 在此上下文中，clutter 指的是雜亂無章、無價值的東西。作者用這個詞來形容那些由 AI 自動生成、缺乏藝術價值且幾乎無人收聽的歌曲。因此，透過移除這些歌曲來「清理數位雜物」，意指去除這些無用的內容，選項 A 最符合語意。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article regarding Tidal's new policy?

options.A: Tidal is banning all forms of AI technology to save money.
options.B: Tidal is taking a strict stance against fully AI-generated music to protect human artists and platform quality.
options.C: Tidal is struggling to compete with other streaming platforms that allow AI music.
options.D: Tidal is planning to replace all human musicians with AI in the future.

quiz.explanationZh: 本文主旨為 Tidal 為了保護人類藝術家的權益及維護平台價值，決定採取比其他平台更嚴格的措施，刪除完全由 AI 生成的音樂。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章提到仍允許 AI 輔助創作；選項 C 與 D 皆與文章內容不符，故選 B。
